rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose equivalent when explicitly saying that something is safe or suitable to drink.

example.english: This water has been tested and is drinkable.
example.traditional: 呢啲水經過化驗，係可飲用嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 seoi2 ging1 gwo3 faa3 jim6 hai6 ho2 jam2 jung6 ge3

rows.note: Use this when drinkable means pleasant or good in taste rather than merely safe.

example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 caa4 gei2 hou2 jam2 wo3
